articles.title_en: The Green Premium: Environmental Regulation, Environmental Risk and Property Value
articles.title_cn: 绿色溢价：环境规制、环境风险与房产价值
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the effect of the closure and relocation of chemical enterprises along the Yangtze River on housing prices in China. With a difference-in-differences (DiD) model and detailed data on polluting enterprises, house transactions, and environmental complaints, we find that environmental regulation led to a 1.7% increase in housing prices and a 43.3% reduction in perceived environmental risks, as measured by environmental complaints from surrounding residents. In addition, we observe a greater change in property values among taller buildings than among shorter buildings. This paper elucidates how developing countries can benefit from environmental regulation by influencing residents’ risk perceptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了长江沿岸化工企业关停与搬迁对中国房价的影响。利用双重差分（DiD）模型以及关于污染企业、房屋交易和环境投诉的详细数据，我们发现环境规制导致房价上涨1.7%，并以周边居民环境投诉衡量的感知环境风险下降43.3%。此外，我们观察到高层建筑相较于低层建筑，其房产价值变化更大。本文阐明了发展中国家如何通过影响居民的风险感知从环境规制中获益。

articles.title_en: Land Subsidence Impacts and Optimal Groundwater Management in South Africa
articles.title_cn: 南非地面沉降影响与最优地下水管理
articles.abstract_en: Fresh surface water is increasingly becoming scarcer worldwide, leading to significant groundwater over-extraction. However, groundwater over-extraction could result in many environmental externalities including various land subsidence (LS) effects. LS causes the gradual reduction of the voids and the subsequent ground surface sinking. The loss of aquifer system storage capacity, owing to LS, is one such negative externality that is seldom discussed in the economic literature. In this paper, we investigate the indirect loss of the aquifer system storage capacity due to LS along with other direct LS negative externalities. We develop a dynamic economic optimization model for groundwater utilization and evaluate various policy instruments (quota systems, taxes on land sinking and aquifer storage loss, and packaging and sequencing of taxes and quotas) to prevent overexploitation externalities. The model is calibrated to South African data. We found that taxes on land sinking and aquifer system storage capacity reduction have a significant effect on withdrawals and water table levels. Taxes provide larger social welfare. In addition, under certain circumstances, quotas are preferable when it comes to supporting groundwater conservation practices. Packaging and sequencing provide the second largest social benefits.
articles.abstract_cn: 淡水地表水在全球范围内日益稀缺，导致地下水过度开采问题严重。然而，地下水过度开采可能引发许多环境外部性，包括各种地面沉降（LS）效应。地面沉降导致空隙逐渐减少，进而引起地表下沉。由于地面沉降导致的含水层系统储水能力损失，是经济文献中很少讨论的一种负外部性。在本文中，我们研究了地面沉降导致的含水层系统储水能力的间接损失以及其他直接的地面沉降负外部性。我们开发了一个地下水利用的动态经济优化模型，并评估了各种政策工具（配额制度、对地面沉降和含水层储水损失征税，以及税收和配额的组合与排序）以防止过度开采外部性。该模型根据南非数据进行了校准。我们发现，对地面沉降和含水层系统储水能力减少征税对取水量和水位有显著影响。税收提供了更大的社会福利。此外，在某些情况下，配额在支持地下水保护实践方面更可取。组合与排序提供了第二大社会福利。

articles.title_en: Air Pollution and Respiratory Infectious Diseases
articles.title_cn: 空气污染与呼吸道传染病
articles.abstract_en: Recent research suggests that short-term exposure to air pollution is associated with an elevated prevalence of respiratory infectious disease. In this paper, we examine the relationship between the air quality index and weekly cases of COVID-19 and influenza-like illnesses (ILI) in the United States. We address potential bias from omitted variables and measurement error with an instrumental variable approach using atmospheric temperature inversions. Unlike other recent studies, we find no relationship between air quality and either COVID-19 or ILI cases.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期研究表明，短期暴露于空气污染与呼吸道传染病患病率升高相关。在本文中，我们考察了美国空气质量指数与每周COVID-19和流感样疾病（ILI）病例之间的关系。我们采用基于大气逆温的工具变量方法，以解决遗漏变量和测量误差可能带来的偏误。与其他近期研究不同，我们发现空气质量与COVID-19或ILI病例之间均无关联。

articles.title_en: Political ‘Colour’ and Firm Behaviour: Evidence from U.S. Power Plants’ Pollution Abatement
articles.title_cn: 政治“色彩”与企业行为：来自美国电厂污染治理的证据
articles.abstract_en: We ask whether firms behave differently depending on the political party in charge, above and beyond responding to any actual differences in policy. We use the pollution abatement behaviour of U.S. Steam Electric Power Plants under the Clean Water Act as our case study. Exploiting the variation provided by the outcome of tightly contested gubernatorial elections, we provide causal evidence that large firms respond to the political ‘colour’ of the governor in the state they operate, even when neither the stringency nor the enforcement of the rules depend on it. Within a theoretical model of the interaction between the regulator and the regulated firms, we show that multiple equilibria arise, and the outcomes of the election provide an effective coordination device. This unexpected behaviour has real-world consequences and leads to significant differences in pollution levels.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨企业是否会根据执政党的不同而表现出不同的行为，而不仅仅是响应政策上的实际差异。我们以《清洁水法》下美国蒸汽发电厂的污染治理行为作为案例研究。利用激烈竞争的州长选举结果所提供的变异性，我们提供了因果证据，表明大型企业会对其运营所在州州长的政治“色彩”作出反应，即使规则的严格性或执行力度并不取决于此。在监管机构与被监管企业之间相互作用的理论模型中，我们表明会出现多重均衡，而选举结果提供了一种有效的协调机制。这种意外行为具有现实世界的后果，并导致污染水平的显著差异。

articles.title_en: Health Benefits from Improved Air Quality: Evidence from Pollution Regulations in China’s “ $$2{+}26$$ ” Cities
articles.title_cn: 空气质量改善的健康效益：来自中国“ $$2{+}26$$ ”城市污染法规的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study assesses the health benefits of better air quality by examining the causal impact of China’s stringent “ $$2{+}26$$ ” regional air pollution control policy on local air quality and population health. Employing a spatial regression discontinuity design that capitalizes on the policy’s location-specific features, we present compelling evidence that the $$2{+}26$$ policy results in an average reduction of 12.2 units in the local Air Quality Index (AQI) and a 47.0% decrease in per capita medical expenditure from 2014 to 2018. A one-unit reduction in AQI corresponds to a 0.88% reduction in per capita annual medical spending, equivalent to RMB 30.2 (US$4.6). These health gains stem from reduced chronic disease prevalence and improved subjective well-being. Nationally, air quality improvement during 2014–2018 could save RMB 674 billion (US$104 billion) annually in national direct medical costs, constituting 11.6% of national medical expenditure in 2018. Our findings underscore the substantial health and welfare gains achievable through pollution controls in developing countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究通过考察中国严格的“ $$2{+}26$$ ”区域空气污染控制政策对当地空气质量和人口健康的因果影响，评估了空气质量改善的健康效益。利用空间断点回归设计，充分利用该政策的地理位置特定特征，我们提供了有力证据表明，$$2{+}26$$政策使当地空气质量指数（AQI）平均降低12.2个单位，人均医疗支出从2014到2018下降了47.0%。AQI每降低一个单位，人均年医疗支出相应减少0.88%，相当于人民币30.2元（美元4.6）。这些健康收益源于慢性病患病率的降低和主观幸福感的提升。在全国范围内，2014-2018期间的空气质量改善每年可节省国家直接医疗费用人民币674亿元（美元104亿元），占2018年全国医疗支出的11.6%。我们的研究结果强调了发展中国家通过污染控制可实现的显著健康与福利收益。

articles.title_en: Area-Based Hedonic Pricing of Urban Green Amenities in Beijing: A Spatial Piecewise Approach
articles.title_cn: 基于面积的城市绿色便利设施享乐定价：北京的空间分段方法
articles.abstract_en: This study explores a spatial piecewise approach for the hedonic valuation of the area of urban green space at different distances from a property, using a rich census dataset collected from Beijing. We explore three novel empirical strategies that improve the identification of the spatial boundary or threshold distance within which green space is capitalised into housing prices. We first delineated a series of concentric circles surrounding each property and measured the area of green space within each doughnut-shaped ring. We next estimated the hedonic price using three methods. The first is a regression spline model combined with a machine learning type of model selection procedure which objectively selects the exact location of the threshold distance that optimises the model’s predictive performance. The second is a novel matching algorithm that minimises covariate imbalance for a continuous treatment variable (i.e., the area of green space) to provide stronger causal evidence on the hedonic prices of green space at different distances. The third is a spatial difference-in-differences approach that further accounts for endogeneity bias associated with unobserved factors. For our dataset, we found that housing prices are more likely to be affected by green space within a 1 km radius.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用从北京收集的丰富普查数据集，探讨了一种空间分段方法，用于评估不同距离处城市绿地面积的享乐价值。我们探索了三种新颖的实证策略，以改进绿地资本化到房价中的空间边界或阈值距离的识别。我们首先围绕每处房产划定一系列同心圆，并测量每个环形区域内的绿地面积。接下来，我们使用三种方法估计享乐价格。第一种是回归样条模型，结合机器学习类型的模型选择程序，该程序客观地选择优化模型预测性能的阈值距离的确切位置。第二种是一种新颖的匹配算法，该算法最小化连续处理变量（即绿地面积）的协变量不平衡，以提供不同距离处绿地享乐价格的更强因果证据。第三种是空间双重差分方法，进一步考虑了与未观测因素相关的内生性偏差。对于我们的数据集，我们发现房价更可能受到1公里半径内绿地的影响。

articles.title_en: Democratic Climate Policies with Overlapping Generations
articles.title_cn: 代际重叠下的民主气候政策
articles.abstract_en: An extensive climate policy literature provides various recommendations for mitigating climate change, but these recommendations are not supported democratically, since the models employed consider either infinitely-lived individuals or normative social objectives (or both). In contrast, the present paper provides policy recommendations capable of incorporating democratic processes. I develop an overlapping generation model with political process micro-foundations and show how democratic climate policies are interconnected with other democratic policies. Time inconsistent social objectives combined with commitment issues lead to an inefficient tax on capital accumulation and a climate policy below the efficient level; while suppressing the tax on capital accumulation generates a climate policy even further below the efficient level. I derive a novel politico-economic Keynes–Ramsey rule for the market interest rate, which is useful for calculating the climate policy level. I show that individual pure time preference, individual altruism toward descendants, and young generation political power are key determinants of democratic climate policy ambition.
articles.abstract_cn: 广泛的气候政策文献为减缓气候变化提供了各种建议，但这些建议并未得到民主支持，因为所采用的模型要么考虑无限期生存的个体，要么考虑规范性社会目标（或两者兼有）。相比之下，本文提供的政策建议能够纳入民主进程。我构建了一个具有政治过程微观基础的代际重叠模型，并展示了民主气候政策如何与其他民主政策相互关联。时间不一致的社会目标与承诺问题相结合，导致对资本积累的税收无效率以及气候政策低于有效水平；而抑制资本积累税则使气候政策进一步低于有效水平。我推导出一个新颖的政治经济凯恩斯-拉姆齐规则，用于市场利率，该规则有助于计算气候政策水平。我表明，个体纯时间偏好、个体对后代的利他主义以及年轻一代的政治权力是民主气候政策雄心的关键决定因素。

articles.title_en: Social Costs of Methane and Carbon Dioxide in a Tipping Climate
articles.title_cn: 气候临界点下甲烷与二氧化碳的社会成本
articles.abstract_en: Social costs for methane and carbon dioxide emissions, from the risk of climate tipping events and deterministic damages, are derived in an analytically tractable model. In the core model: social costs from tipping risks rise with income, just as they do for deterministic damages, and depend on only a few parameters. Consequently, methane’s weight (its social cost relative to carbon dioxide) is constant and independent of temperature projections. But other damage and tipping probability formulations assumed in the literature imply methane’s weight varies over time and with temperature projections. (JEL H23, O44, Q40, Q54, Q56, Q58).
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个可解析处理的模型中，推导了甲烷和二氧化碳排放的社会成本，这些成本来源于气候临界事件的风险和确定性损害。在核心模型中：来自临界点风险的社会成本随收入增加而上升，正如确定性损害一样，并且仅依赖于少数几个参数。因此，甲烷的权重（其相对于二氧化碳的社会成本）是恒定的，且与温度预测无关。但文献中假设的其他损害和临界概率公式意味着甲烷的权重随时间变化并随温度预测而变化。（JEL H23, O44, Q40, Q54, Q56, Q58）。

articles.title_en: Quota Consolidation in Norwegian Coastal Fisheries
articles.title_cn: 挪威沿海渔业中的配额整合
articles.abstract_en: Balancing the trade-off between economic efficiency and social objectives has been a challenge for natural resource managers under rights-based management. While the actual prioritization should be guided by social preferences, the mechanisms and consequences of the quota transfer system need to be well understood. We investigate the effects of the quota transfer scheme implemented in the Norwegian coastal cod fishery in 2004. This is a small-scale fishery that has traditionally been important for employment in the northern part of Norway. Using vessel-level quota registry data, we estimate the effect of quota trading on vessel exit using a difference-in-differences approach that exploits variation in implementation timing between regulatory groups. In addition, we describe the outcome of quota consolidation with descriptive statistics. Our results confirm that the quota transfer scheme accelerates the exit of vessels from the fishery by at least 5% points in the short run. The descriptive analysis reveals great heterogeneity in both the size and geographic location of exiting vessels, suggesting that the scheme has distributional impacts. While the policy change has the expected effects in the short run, our results suggest that the implications of consolidation last longer. This has implications for policymakers trying to balance economic efficiency and social objectives of rational fishery management.
articles.abstract_cn: 在基于权利的管理下，平衡经济效率与社会目标之间的权衡一直是自然资源管理者面临的挑战。虽然实际优先次序应由社会偏好指导，但配额转让制度的机制和后果需要充分理解。我们研究了2004年在挪威沿海鳕鱼渔业中实施的配额转让计划的效果。这是一个小规模渔业，传统上对挪威北部的就业具有重要意义。利用船舶层面的配额登记数据，我们采用双重差分法估计配额交易对船舶退出的影响，该方法利用了监管群体之间实施时间的差异。此外，我们通过描述性统计描述了配额整合的结果。我们的结果证实，配额转让计划在短期内使渔船退出渔业的概率至少提高了5%个百分点。描述性分析揭示了退出船舶在规模和地理位置上的巨大异质性，表明该计划具有分配性影响。虽然政策变化在短期内产生了预期效果，但我们的结果表明，整合的影响持续时间更长。这对试图在合理渔业管理中平衡经济效率和社会目标的政策制定者具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Quickest Detection of Ecological Regimes for Natural Resource Management
articles.title_cn: 自然资源管理中生态状态的快速检测
articles.abstract_en: We study the stochastic dynamics of natural resources under the threat of ecological regime shifts. We establish a Pareto optimal framework of regime shift detection under uncertainty that minimizes the delay with which economic agents become aware of the shift. We integrate ecosystem surveillance in the formation of optimal resource extraction policies. We fully solve the case of a profit-maximizing monopolist, study its response to regime shift detection and show the generality of our framework by extending our results to other decision makers and functional forms. We apply our framework to the case of the Cantareira water reservoir in São Paulo, Brazil, and study the events that led to its depletion and the consequent water supply crisis.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在生态状态转变威胁下自然资源的随机动态。我们建立了一个在不确定性下进行状态转变检测的帕累托最优框架，该框架最小化了经济主体意识到转变的延迟。我们将生态系统监测整合到最优资源开采政策的形成中。我们完全解决了利润最大化垄断者的情况，研究了其对状态转变检测的响应，并通过将我们的结果扩展到其他决策者和函数形式来展示我们框架的普遍性。我们将我们的框架应用于巴西圣保罗的Cantareira水库案例，并研究了导致其枯竭及随后供水危机的事件。
